credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.description: Enter the provider credentials. They are sealed on the server and never shown.

testSend.title: Live send test
testSend.description: Send one real message through the transport you just configured.

alignment.title: SPF, DKIM & DMARC alignment
alignment.description: Check live DNS so both arms look identical to the receiver apart from the infrastructure.

returnPath.title: Return-path capability
returnPath.description: Record whether this provider can carry our own bounce address.

verdict.aligned: Both arms are indistinguishable to the receiver apart from the sending infrastructure.
verdict.singleArm: No second transport is configured, so there is nothing to align yet.
verdict.blocked: Some checks did not pass. Each one below names the DNS change to make.
verdict.unknown: DNS could not be resolved for every check. Nothing is wrong yet — try again shortly.

returnPath.label: Return path
returnPath.supported: This provider carries our own bounce address, so bounces are attributed exactly like the own-MTA arm.
returnPath.unsupported: This provider rewrites the bounce address, so bounce attribution on that arm is coarser. Measurement confidence is lower; sending is unaffected.
returnPath.unknown: Not established yet — the probe settles after a real bounce comes back. Until then the arm is measured conservatively. Nothing is blocked.
returnPath.settlesNote: This one is observed rather than asked for: it settles the first time a bounce comes back through this provider, so a transport you connected a moment ago reads “not known yet”. Nothing waits on it.
returnPath.noReferenceNote: No second transport is connected yet, so there is nothing to record here.

entry.title: Connect an email provider
entry.body: If you already pay for an ESP, you can send through it while your own server warms up — and compare the two. Owlat sends on its own without one; this changes nothing until you choose it.

transportWizard.skipNote: Sending through your own server only. Measurement confidence is lower without a second arm to compare against.

reasons.price: Mentions a price or number I couldn't verify
reasons.ungrounded: States something I couldn't trace back to the conversation
reasons.commitment: Makes a commitment on your behalf
reasons.policy: References a policy or terms worth double-checking
reasons.date: Mentions a date or time worth confirming
reasons.tone: Tone reads harsher than your usual replies
reasons.incomplete: May not answer everything they asked
reasons.vague: Part of the reply is vague and could be misread
reasons.recipient: Double-check names and who the reply addresses
reasons.attachment: Mentions an attachment or link that may be missing
reasons.generic: Something else looked off — worth a skim before you send
reasons.unchecked: I couldn't run my usual checks on this draft, so please read it closely
reasons.lowConfidence: The agent is not confident in this draft — please read it before it goes out
reasons.quickRead: A quick read is worth it before this goes out
reasons.nothingStoodOut: Nothing stood out — the reply looks complete and accurate
reasons.escalation: The agent held this for you instead of answering on its own

mailboxReady.description: Add a personal mailbox so you can send and receive mail here.

aiConnected.title: Connect your AI

importDone.title: Bring your email over
importDone.description: Import your existing inbox so nothing is left behind.

knowledgeIndexed.description: We read your imported mail so drafts and replies sound like you.

sendingSwitched.title: Switch sending to this instance

finish.earliest: Everyone is reached by {day} at the earliest.

errors.labelCharset: Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens (1–63 per label, no leading or trailing hyphen).

duplicateLabel.site: Same as the "App" label — each hostname needs a distinct label.
duplicateLabel.convex: Same as the "API (Convex)" label — each hostname needs a distinct label.
duplicateLabel.convexSite: Same as the "REST API" label — each hostname needs a distinct label.
duplicateLabel.mail: Same as the "Mail server (EHLO)" label — each hostname needs a distinct label.
duplicateLabel.bounce: Same as the "Bounce domain" label — each hostname needs a distinct label.

changed.title: Host key has CHANGED
changed.body: This server is presenting a different key than the one you trusted before. That can mean the server was rebuilt — or that someone is intercepting the connection. Only continue if you know why the key changed.

verify.title: Verify the host key
verify.body: First time connecting — confirm this matches your server's fingerprint.

errors.passwordTooShort: Admin password must be at least {min} characters.
errors.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match.

dnsNotes.ptr: Also set reverse DNS (PTR) for this IP at your host.
dnsNotes.spf: SPF — starter value; confirm in Settings → Domains.
dnsNotes.dmarc: DMARC — starter value; tighten after monitoring.

updateReady.title: Update ready
updateReady.body: Owlat {version} will be applied the next time you restart.
